name: io.github.Agripp87/memoria-mcp
title: Memoria
description: Persistent, plain-text memory for agents: markdown you own, hybrid search, self-maintenance.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Root directory of the memory store. Defaults to ~/.memoria locally (or /data/memoria in Docker).

environmentVariables.name: MEMORIA_EMBEDDINGS
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: auto (OpenAI when keyed, else local MiniLM, else hash), openai, minilm or hash.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token authenticating /mcp, /ingest and /dashboard/api. Required for the HTTP transport.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORIA_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.1 client secret for remote clients (claude.ai). Required when BIND_ALL=true; keep it distinct from the API key.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORIA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AES-256-GCM master key (64 hex chars) for the collector's encrypted buffer and credential store. Required when BIND_ALL=true.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORIA_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: External URL of this server. Pins the OAuth discovery metadata so it is never derived from the Host header. Required when exposed.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Root directory of the memory store. Defaults to ~/.memoria locally (or /data/memoria in Docker).
